visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a large yellow outdoor banner featuring a stylized lizard graphic and text for '2025 Taiwan Reptile Festival' against a clear blue sky. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle wide shot of a massive indoor exhibition hall crowded with hundreds of people walking between numerous retail booths under industrial high ceilings. (3) A series of quick cuts shows close-ups of small turtles and snakes housed in clear plastic ventilated containers, some with wood shavings. (4) A man wearing glasses, a black baseball cap, and a red-and-black varsity jacket appears, holding a bright yellow gecko on his palms; his face shows a wide, enthusiastic smile. (5) Rapid montage of various animals: a green mossy frog on a hand, the scaly head of a monitor lizard, and a black-and-yellow salamander facing the camera. (6) A person in a large, realistic triceratops costume interacts with a child's hand in a crowded aisle. (7) A man holds a giant beetle on his finger while onlookers in the background watch with curious expressions. (8) Close-up shots of a blue-tongued skink being held, a turtle swimming in a small tank, and price tags inside plastic containers. (9) A detailed close-up shows a large, dark brown and reddish gecko (Giant Gecko) crawling across a person's hand and wrist; the skin texture is highly detailed. (10) The main character (man in cap) is shown with two large snakes—one pure white and one dark brown—draped around his shoulders, smiling at the camera. (11) Close-ups of diamondback terrapins with distinctive spotted patterns in water-filled acrylic tanks, accompanied by a price tag showing '250,000'. (12) Shots of a 'Special Exhibition Area' featuring designer toys, colorful lizard-themed illustrations from a contest, and an elaborate bioactive vivarium with a stone eagle head and miniature trees. (13) The video ends by returning to the outdoor banner shot, followed by a final shot of the main character holding the yellow gecko with a social media overlay.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One main male host, two children interacting with costume, and a large crowd of over 20 distinct individuals in the exhibition hall background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An adult male with short hair, wearing thick-rimmed glasses, a black baseball cap worn forward, and a red-and-black varsity jacket with white stripes on the collar and cuffs.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between an outdoor urban setting featuring a large promotional banner and a vast indoor exhibition hall with exposed metal ceiling beams, bright floodlights, and numerous partitioned booths filled with reptile enclosures and merchandise.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately over a driving, upbeat electronic BGM with a strong kick drum. The vocal is bright and enthusiastic. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX accompanies the first major visual transition, followed by a light 'ding' notification sound synchronized with text appearing. (3) Narrator's pitch rises dramatically as he lists animal types, punctuated by percussive hit SFX on each item. Background crowd murmur is faintly audible but heavily ducked. (4) Vocal intensity increases into a shouting register when discussing prices, accompanied by a 'cash register' style ding. The BGM maintains a steady, driving tempo. (5) A cartoonish 'buzzer' sound effect plays to mark a negative comparison, followed by a rapid-fire sequence of descriptions. (6) Music reaches a rhythmic climax with synth stabs during the final promotional call to action, ending with a clean fade-out of both vocal and BGM layers.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and showcase the scale and high-value highlights of the 2025 Taiwan Reptile Festival, enticing enthusiasts to attend by highlighting rare, expensive exotic pets and a variety of cultural exhibition zones.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names and tours a specific event ('Taiwan Reptile Festival') and encourages viewers to follow the creator for more content related to these 'special pets'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-arousal social media editing style characterized by extremely high text density, fast cuts, and frequent comedic SFX to maintain viewer attention on niche subject matter.
